theorem_reviews.name: NCPS.ModelClosure.evaluate_eq_true_iff_accepts
theorem_reviews.conclusion: The modeled executable gate returns true exactly when the declared Accepts conjunction holds.
theorem_reviews.interpretation: A complete soundness/completeness correspondence for this particular modeled finding gate.
theorem_reviews.limitation: Report fields are asserted findings. No theorem relates them to raw payload parsing, actual signatures, signer authorization, source hashing, attribution mapping, revocation, current revision, or private linkage.

theorem_reviews.name: NCPS.ModelClosure.evaluate_eq_false_iff_not_accepts
theorem_reviews.conclusion: The Boolean gate returns false exactly when Accepts does not hold.
theorem_reviews.interpretation: Rejection is the exact Boolean complement of the modeled acceptance conjunction.
theorem_reviews.limitation: The theorem does not distinguish operational failure reasons or supply the evidence required to populate report findings.

theorem_reviews.name: NCPS.ModelClosure.framed_encode_injective
theorem_reviews.quantification: Every Record type, codec, fixed byte tag, and pair of records.
theorem_reviews.conclusion: Equal fixed-tag framed encodings imply equal records.
explicit_premises: RoundTrip codec: for every record, decode(encode(record)) = some record.
theorem_reviews.interpretation: Composition of the existing codec-injectivity and fixed-prefix cancellation proofs.
theorem_reviews.limitation: RoundTrip remains a required supplied hypothesis. Neither JCS round-trip conformance nor domain separation across arbitrary distinct tags nor signature/hash collision resistance is proved.

theorem_reviews.name: NCPS.ModelClosure.extensional_pair_set_not_injective
theorem_reviews.quantification: The mapping of all ordered byte-sequence pairs to the corresponding extensional two-item membership predicate.
theorem_reviews.conclusion: That mapping is not injective because swapping distinct ordered values preserves the set.
theorem_reviews.interpretation: A kernel-checked boundary showing that order cannot be recovered from the extensional set projection.
theorem_reviews.limitation: The counterexample is over generic byte pairs. It is not a new attack on the complete ordered companion JSON payload. The original manuscript already discloses this distinction.

evidence.finding: The manuscript requires structured independent findings and concrete parsing, schema, cryptographic, trust and source checks. The extension proves only their abstract decision conjunction.
The manuscript requires concrete semantic correspondence and conformance. These remain unsupplied by the abstract finding gate.
Sets do not retain discovery order or multiplicity; ordered occurrence interfaces remain separate.
The manuscript explicitly reports swap collision for the set extractor and distinct Lean4.24 source/receipt identities. This Lean4.22 proof does not rerun or replace those separate sources.
